title: Dyadic parallelogram is a REAL 2D rotation; ||A-B|| (chi-twisted odd-half period) breaks coherence, tying gap to Lam-Leung antipodal rigidity
evidence: Probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C072_parallelogram_descent.py, exact field arithmetic + complex eta, PRIZE regime ONLY (n=2^mu proper subgroup, q prime ~n^beta, beta in {4,5}, n<<sqrt q), 7 instances mu=3..6, q up to 3.36e7. At the WORST coset b* (argmax over mu_{2k}-coset transversal of |eta(mu_{2k},b)|) I decompose via eta_halving: A=eta_b(mu_k), B=eta_{b*zeta}(mu_k), A+B=eta_b(mu_{2k}) (reconstruction residual 7e-15, parallelogram residual 2e-13 -- the identity is EXACT). DECISIVE: (1) the alignment angle between A and B at b* is 0.0deg in ALL 7 cases -- A,B are real and SAME-SIGN, perfectly aligned: the worst case IS the coherent fixed point (||A+B|| max <=> ||A-B|| min, exactly the parallelogram prediction), so C072's bet that ||A-B|| is bounded below AT b* is FALSE -- it is small (r_twist=||A-B||/sqrt(k)=0.056..1.46, smallest where the house is largest). (2) The descent CONCLUSION ||A||^2+||B||^2 <= 2k = 2 M(k)^2 FAILS in 7/7 cases, badly (28.6 vs 8 at mu=3; 776 vs 64 at mu=6): the dyadic halving INFLATES, never controls -- matching docs/kb/deltastar-407-dyadic-2adic-gauss-tower-verdict-2026-06-13.md ('-1-closure is UPWARD pressure, not a cancellation lever'). (3) Even with ||A-B||>0 the parallelogram yields only B(mu_{2k})^2 <= 2(||A||^2+||B||^2) <= 4 B(mu_k)^2, i.e. B(mu_{2k}) <= 2 B(mu_k): this is the TRIVIAL two-term triangle inequality, not sqrt-cancellation. The descent's actual hypothesis ||A||^2+||B||^2 <= k(1+o(1)) is precisely the BGK sqrt-cancellation at level k restated (probe shows C0(k)=B(mu_k)/sqrt(k) is 2.0..4.2 in-regime, NOT ~1, so the lower level is itself uncancelled). The cited Lean lemmas DyadicHalvingRecursion.conj_eta_nthRoots / eta_halving are genuine and axiom-clean [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], but they encode only the exact two-term split + reality; neither states nor implies any bound -- the parallelogram is content-free as a descent lever.
wall: W-BGK: the parallelogram carries the open BGK/Paley sqrt-cancellation problem one level DOWN the dyadic tower (||A||^2+||B||^2 <= k(1+o(1)) is the same conjecture at level k) without reducing it; LamLeungTwoPow governs only char-0 vanishing (= antipodal pairs, the -1-closure), which the probe and the prior tower verdict both show is upward pressure, not a cancellation mechanism for the mod-p house.
honest_note: OPEN, not a closure, not a refutation of any in-tree theorem (the cited Lean lemmas are correct -- C072 over-reads them). The novel framing (worst case = coherent 2D fixed point) is CONFIRMED exactly by the probe (align=0deg), but it cuts AGAINST C072's mechanism: at the worst b the twisted period ||A-B|| is minimized, not bounded below, so it does not 'break coherence'. The Lam-Leung antipodal link is real char-0 structure but, as the 4-wall tower verdict (2026-06-13) already established, the -1=zeta^{n/2} closure inflates C0 (dyadic 1.21 vs odd-order 0.96) rather than forcing descent; this probe independently reproduces that (descent conclusion fails 7/7). Probe uses exact integer field arithmetic (sympy-free primality + multiplicative order via primitive root) and scans mu_n-coset transversals (eta is constant on mu_n-cosets) so the worst-b search is exact, not sampled. Regime is strictly the prize regime; no full-group / small-prime false positives. This connection welds straight back to W-BGK; it should be logged as an OPEN-weld (parallelogram lever is content-free) alongside the dyadic-tower verdict in DISPROOF_LOG.
